audit_meta.grade_reason: 5 P1 findings (threshold: ≤2 for C), 24% spec coverage (threshold: ≥40% for C). All findings are NEW — first audit baseline.
audit_meta.skip_reason: Backend service not running at http://localhost:3001

escalations.title: Handlebars ≤4.7.9 — 11 JS Injection / XSS CVEs (RCE risk)
escalations.finding_summary: Handlebars ≤4.7.9 carries 11 injection/XSS CVEs with RCE risk if templates render user-supplied data. Source/Backend must upgrade to ≥4.8.0.

escalations.category: CVE / missing access control / IP spoofing
escalations.title: proxy-addr ≤2.0.7 — IPv4-Mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing (CVSS 9.1)
escalations.finding_summary: proxy-addr ≤2.0.7 allows IP spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust (CVSS 9.1). Any IP-based ACL or rate limiting in the Backend can be bypassed.

escalations.title: tinypool ≤2.1.1 — Prototype Pollution → RCE (via vitest)
escalations.finding_summary: tinypool ≤2.1.1 has prototype pollution gadget chains enabling RCE in test worker processes. Fixed by upgrading vitest to ≥5.0.3.

escalations.title: vitest ≤4.1.10 — Critical Vulnerability (direct Frontend dependency)
escalations.finding_summary: vitest v4 (direct Frontend dependency) carries a critical vulnerability enabling test sandbox bypass or prototype pollution RCE. Upgrade to ≥5.0.0.

escalations.title: @vitest/mocker path traversal — arbitrary file read during test mocking
escalations.finding_summary: @vitest/mocker <4.1.11 allows path traversal during mock redirect, enabling arbitrary file read from the filesystem. Fixed via vitest ≥4.1.11.

p1.title: GET /api/search not wired into app.ts — intentionally failing tests
p1.detail: The GET /api/search route is tested (5 cases) and called by DependencyPicker.tsx but never registered in app.ts. Every search call returns 404.
p1.recommendation: Implement GET /api/search?q= in workflow.ts or search.ts, register in app.ts, remove intentional-failure note.

p2.title: Route handlers call workItemStore directly, bypassing service layer
p2.detail: Three route files import and call workItemStore directly. CLAUDE.md mandates a service layer. Only dashboard.ts uses a service correctly.
p2.recommendation: Create workItemService.ts; route handlers import the service, not the store.

p2.title: Traceability enforcer only checks most-recent plan — structurally blind
p2.detail: get_active_requirements() uses max(req_files, key=os.path.getmtime) — only one plan checked. 80+ FRs go unchecked while CI reports PASSED.
p2.recommendation: Add --all-plans flag; add --spec-file path for Specifications/.

p2.title: 77 Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md FRs have zero implementation
p2.detail: Domain spec defines a full platform (FR-001..FR-069 plus FR-0002..FR-0007). Current Source/ implements none of it.
p2.recommendation: Decide status of the spec (roadmap / archived / parallel product) and annotate accordingly.

p2.title: Jest 29.7.0 — 33 high-severity vulnerabilities (braces DoS, micromatch)
p2.detail: Jest 29 dependency tree carries 33 high CVEs including catastrophic backtracking in braces/micromatch. Fix requires major version bump to ≥30.5.2.
p2.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update jest (breaking — test compatibility review required)

p2.title: @remix-run/router open redirect via protocol-relative URLs (GHSA-2j2x-hqr9-3h42)
p2.detail: Same-origin redirect with path starting // causes open redirect. Allows attacker to redirect users to attacker-controlled domains.

p3.title: Duplicate frontend test files with divergent mocks
p3.detail: Two test files per page with different mock setups. Root-level versions are shallower; tests/pages/ versions are more complete. Risk of silent divergence.
p3.recommendation: Remove root-level duplicates; keep tests/pages/ versions.

p3.title: FR-dependency-* requirements invisible to enforcer; 3 still incomplete
p3.detail: FR-dependency-api-types (missing blocked_by fields), FR-dependency-seed (no seed data), FR-dependency-frontend-tests (no test files) all incomplete but enforcer never sees this plan.
p3.recommendation: Update plan paths (portal/ → Source/); implement or defer the 3 incomplete FRs.

p3.title: eslint-disable suppresses react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without documented rationale
p3.detail: Two production files suppress react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without inline explanation. Risk of stale-closure bugs going undetected.
p3.recommendation: Fix dependency arrays or add explicit rationale comments.

p3.title: qs ≤6.15.3 — 3 DoS vulnerabilities via malformed query parameters
sprintf-js ≤1.1.3 — unbounded precision specifiers cause CPU DoS

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Stale npm dependency tree across all 5 projects
cross_reference_map.single_fix: npm audit fix + targeted major upgrades per remediation plan (Phase 1/2/3)

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Missing service layer between routes and data store
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Create workItemService.ts; wire GET /api/search through it; refactor route handlers
